abstract: Two historical identities test whether crypto perpetual-futures returns reverse after common movement is removed. One uses a 24-hour residual signal; the other combines 24- and 72-hour residuals. Both are strongly negative in the implemented direction. Their immutable annualized Sharpe summaries are -2.1527 and -2.1140 across 1,574 observations. The result rejects the tested reversal rule, but it does not automatically establish the opposite momentum trade. Exact curves, maximum drawdowns, costs, funding attribution, and current-union DSR are not preserved at the family level. The family contributes zero sleeves and remains in the trial union as a negative result.

title: Crypto Short-Horizon Reversal: Two Decisive Negative Trials
